title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 SVCB RDATA Wire Parser Work Item
summary: Add a bounded ServiceMode SVCB RDATA parser for RFC 9461 DNS service binding records.
planned_changes:
- Add `DnsServiceBindingWireRecord` as a pure RDATA parser.
- Add a generic `DnsServiceBindingServiceParameter` decoder for RFC 9460 SVCB key/value pairs.
- Decode SvcPriority, uncompressed TargetName, sorted SvcParams, `alpn`, `port`, and `dohpath` values.
- Reuse existing `DnsServiceBindingRecord` scalar validation and endpoint-selection inputs.
- Add requirement-owned positive, negative, edge, and fuzz-style tests.
- Add a permanent BenchmarkDotNet parser suite and run a Dry smoke locally.
- Update RFC 9461 trace artifacts and generated triage.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused RFC 9461 requirement-home tests, the SVCB RDATA parser BenchmarkDotNet Dry smoke, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full local Release solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Host resolver installation or encrypted DNS session establishment.
completion_notes: RFC 9461 now has a trace-owned ServiceMode SVCB RDATA parsing surface suitable for local resolver/discovery adapters.
